data_nth_nat.note: data_nth_nat d i: the natural at position i of an output datum read through its Dcons cells; position 0 of a cell is its head's natural value (n for Dnat n, 0 for any other entry), position j+1 is position j of the tail; a scalar Dnat n, also as a malformed tail, reads n at its position 0 and 0 after; Dnil and Dpair read 0 everywhere. On an encoded list of naturals it is nth 0, so positions past the end read 0. A natural reader only: the modulo-k / modulo-3 colouring adapters and the vertex enum rank are separate.
